name: CAREPLS
recent: Careplus 正在推进一项可放弃配售新股计划，最多发行 425,394,849 股配售新股，每 2 股现有股份配 1 股，预计筹集最多 RM30 million，用于资助电动车中心。公司已获得 Bursa Securities 批准上市配售新股，并将于 2026 年 11 月 25 日召开 EGM 寻求股东批准。此外，涉及先前宣布的资产处置。
notable: 最多发行 425,394,849 股新股，拟筹集最多 RM30 million。
Bursa Securities 已批准配售新股的上市及报价。
涉及先前宣布的资产处置。
risks: 配售新股将导致现有股东股权被摊薄（若未全额认购）。
公司近期董事及主要股东出现股权变动申报。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度，营收为 RM28.79 million，环比增长 39.4%，同比增长 54.3%；净亏损为 RM6.47 million，净利率为 -22.5%，较上一季度的 -9.7% 扩大。

recent_en: Careplus is undertaking a renounceable rights issue of up to 425,394,849 new shares on the basis of 1 rights share for every 2 existing shares, aiming to raise up to RM30 million to fund an EV hub. Bursa Securities has approved the listing of the rights shares, and an EGM is scheduled for 25 November 2026 to seek shareholder approval. Separately, the company proposed a supplemental agreement to the sale and purchase agreement with Delloyd Asset Portfolio for a previously announced disposal.
notable_en: Proposed renounceable rights issue of up to 425,394,849 new shares on a 1-for-2 basis to raise up to RM30 million.
Bursa Securities has approved the listing and quotation of the rights shares.
Proposed supplemental agreement to the sale and purchase agreement with Delloyd Asset Portfolio for a previously announced disposal.
risks_en: The rights issue will dilute existing shareholders' equity if not fully subscribed.
Recent filings show changes in directors' and substantial shareholders' interests.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM28.79 million, up 39.4% QoQ and 54.3% YoY; net loss was RM6.47 million with a net margin of -22.5%, widening from -9.7% in the previous quarter.
